recipe.visualDefinition: A cinematic nocturnal scene featuring two young protagonists in a mystical forest. A boy stands holding a thick rope swing while a girl kneels beside him holding a glowing lantern that casts a warm amber light. The background is a deep, cool blue forest containing a rustic treehouse and a derelict car, with magical sparks and a crescent moon visible through the dense canopy.
coreVisualRelationships: Warm lantern light contrasting against a cool blue monochromatic environment
Protagonists positioned centrally as the primary focal point
Vertical elements of trees and rope framing the subjects
Text placed in the upper third, integrated into the dark canopy
coreInvariants: Dual-tone color palette (Deep Blue vs. Amber Gold)
Low-angle perspective looking slightly up at the subjects

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Full-body subjects centered vertically, occupying the middle 60% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The glowing lantern held by the girl, serving as the primary light source and focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the lantern, moves up to the children's faces, then follows the rope upward to the title text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dense but dark negative space in the upper corners provided by tree foliage.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Midnight blue and cyan tones for the forest and shadows.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm amber and orange for the lantern glow and highlights on the skin.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Golden yellow for the primary typography.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the bright lantern/text and the deep, dark forest shadows.
paletteRestrictions: Maintain a strict blue-orange complementary scheme

letterConstructionRules: Small caps used for connecting words
characterSpecificRedesigns: Interlocking or tight kerning for secondary words
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Classical serif for impact paired with a wide-tracked minimalist sans-serif for metadata.

avoid: Modernist sans-serif for the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the cinematic Roman serif aesthetic and sharp terminals.
Provides a similar fantasy/epic feel with sharp serifs.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A cinematic nocturnal forest scene in deep blue tones. In the center, a boy stands holding a thick rope and a girl kneels holding a lit lantern. The lantern light should cast a warm amber glow on their faces and the immediate ground. In the background, include a faint treehouse and a rusted car shell. Add magical sparks and a crescent moon in the sky.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the main title in a large, golden, beveled serif font in the upper third. Above it, add a subtitle in a thin, white, wide-tracked sans-serif font. Ensure the golden text has a subtle outer glow to separate it from the dark trees.

verificationChecks: Is the lantern the primary light source for the characters?
Is the forest background predominantly monochromatic blue?
Does the title text have a 3D beveled appearance?
Is the subtitle tracking significantly wider than the main title?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the rope is held naturally by the boy.
Check that the lantern light affects the girl's face and the ground correctly.
Verify the text is centered and uses the specified golden/white hierarchy.
Confirm the background elements (car, treehouse) are visible but secondary.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a cool-toned nocturnal environment with a single warm-toned light source held by central characters, topped with beveled golden serif typography for a fantasy-adventure aesthetic.
